query: 2026 gubernatorial debates scheduled summer 2026 Pennsylvania Shapiro Garrity, Oregon Kotek Drazan, Arizona Hobbs, Wisconsin - any debate before September 2026
answer:
## Summary

**Direct answer to the research question: No general-election gubernatorial debate is scheduled before September 2026 in any of the four states — and none was found scheduled anywhere in the U.S.** All confirmed 2026 general-election governor debates fall in October.

**Pennsylvania (Shapiro vs. Garrity)** — Nothing scheduled, no date proposed by either side. Both said in late June they'd do "at least one"; Garrity called for seven (one per media market) with no dates; Shapiro's camp refuses to negotiate publicly. As of late June the campaigns hadn't started working out details. PA had no debate at all in 2022; the last was 2018.

**Oregon (Kotek vs. Drazan)** — The closest near-miss anywhere. The Oregon Newspaper Publishers Association event on **July 24** is traditionally the season kickoff (it was the first 2022 general debate, held July 29, 2022), but Kotek declined and Drazan appeared alone. The two agreed debates are **Oct 1** (Eugene, tentative) and **Oct 7** (Medford, KOBI — confirmed by press release naming both). Kotek's June challenge said debates would "begin in September," but they didn't. Oregon's only September gubernatorial events are one-sided: a KPTV/law-enforcement debate (September, date TBD) and the OBI forum **Sept 24** — Drazan accepted both, Kotek neither.

**Arizona (Hobbs vs. Biggs)** — Note the nominee is **Andy Biggs**, who won the July 21 GOP primary. Clean Elections has the Governor debate on **Oct 6**; the earliest statewide general debate on the whole calendar is Mine Inspector on Aug 31. Hobbs issued a blanket refusal of all debate invitations on July 30; Biggs will attend Oct 6. Hobbs hasn't debated since 2018.

**Wisconsin (Crowley vs. Tiffany)** — Crowley narrowly won the Aug 11 primary. Two October events proposed: TMJ4 town hall **Oct 8** and WBA Foundation debate **Oct 9**. As of **Aug 18**, neither campaign has committed to anything. Wisconsin's historical pattern is one to two debates, all mid-to-late October.

**National context:** Maine's earliest is Oct 1, Georgia Oct 12, Florida Oct 15, Michigan October, Nevada explicitly post-Labor Day. Every pre-September 2026 gubernatorial debate that actually occurred (Rhode Island, Minnesota, Oklahoma, Kansas, Wisconsin, Arizona, Michigan, Vermont) was a primary or runoff debate.

Several primary sources (azcleanelections.gov, azmedia.org, kobi5.com, koin.com, kgw.com) blocked direct fetches with 403/451; I retrieved their content via cached search indexes and cross-checked each against independent news reporting.

key_facts: NO general-election gubernatorial debate is scheduled before September 2026 in Pennsylvania, Oregon, Arizona, or Wisconsin. None was identified anywhere in the United States.
The earliest scheduled 2026 general-election gubernatorial DEBATE anywhere in the U.S. is October 1, 2026 (Maine's News Center Maine/Maine State Chamber debate, and Oregon's tentative Eugene debate).

PENNSYLVANIA: No Shapiro-Garrity debate has been scheduled and no date has been proposed by either side. Both campaigns said (June 23-25, 2026) they are willing to do 'at least one' debate, but as of late June the campaigns had not begun negotiating details.

Garrity called for seven debates on June 23, 2026 -- one in each PA media market (Philadelphia, Pittsburgh, Harrisburg-Lancaster-Lebanon-York, Johnstown-Altoona, Wilkes-Barre/Scranton, Erie, Binghamton NY) -- with no dates attached. Shapiro's camp said it would not 'negotiate the terms of a debate through the press.'

Pennsylvania's last gubernatorial debate was in 2018 (Wolf vs. Wagner, moderated by Alex Trebek). The 2022 cycle produced zero debates. Garrity has never debated a political opponent; Shapiro's last formal debate was 2016.

OREGON: Kotek and Drazan have agreed to exactly two head-to-head debates, both in October -- Oct 1 (tentative, Eugene, Oregon Journalism Project + UO School of Journalism + KEZI) and Oct 7 (Medford, KOBI-TV/NBC5 + Southern Oregon University, 7-8 p.m.).

Oregon's Oregon Newspaper Publishers Association event on July 24, 2026 -- traditionally the kickoff of general-election debate season and the site of the first 2022 general debate -- was scheduled but did NOT become a debate: Kotek declined on June 17, and Drazan appeared alone for over an hour.
Kotek's June 11, 2026 challenge specified three debates that would 'begin in September,' but the two agreed debates both landed in October.

Oregon's only September general-election gubernatorial events are one-sided: a KPTV/law-enforcement-association debate in Portland (September, date TBD) and the Oregon Business & Industry / Portland Business Journal Gubernatorial Candidate Forum on Sept 24 -- Drazan has accepted both; Kotek has not committed to either.

Kotek committed only to the KOIN debate (Oct 13, Portland State University), which Drazan declined. Drazan accepted KGW/The Oregonian (October), KTVZ Bend (Oct 13), and KPTV -- none of which Kotek has accepted.
ARIZONA: The Republican nominee is Rep. Andy Biggs, who won the four-way GOP primary on July 21, 2026 (not Karrin Taylor Robson).

The Arizona Citizens Clean Elections Commission / Arizona Media Association general-election Governor debate is scheduled for Tuesday, October 6, 2026. The earliest statewide general debate on the AZ calendar is Mine Inspector on Aug 31; the first major statewide race debate is Attorney General on Sept 23.

On July 30, 2026, Hobbs' campaign manager Nicole DeMont announced Hobbs will decline all debate invitations, saying 'face-to-face engagement with Arizonans is more effective than a stage designed for short soundbites and political theater.' Biggs says he will attend the Oct 6 debate.

Hobbs has not debated an opponent since October 2018 (Secretary of State race); she skipped both the 2022 Democratic primary debate and the 2022 general debate with Kari Lake. Arizona's governor general-election debate ran unbroken from 1954 to 2018.

As of Aug 5, 2026, Clean Elections Executive Director Tom Collins said the gubernatorial invitation list was still being finalized and that Hobbs 'has to be considered an invitee even if she's going to decline.'

WISCONSIN: David Crowley (D, Milwaukee County Executive) narrowly won the Aug 11, 2026 Democratic primary over Francesca Hong; he faces Republican U.S. Rep. Tom Tiffany for the open seat (Evers retiring).

Two Wisconsin general-election events are proposed, both in October: a TMJ4 + Milwaukee County Intergovernmental Cooperation Council town hall on Oct 8 at 6 p.m. (UW-Milwaukee Zelazo Center) and the WBA Foundation statewide televised debate on Oct 9 at 7 p.m. (hosted by Milwaukee PBS, moderated by Jill Geisler).
As of August 18, 2026, spokespeople for both Crowley and Tiffany said they have not committed to any specific debates.
Wisconsin historical base rates: 2022 had one debate (Oct 14); 2018 had two (Oct 19 and Oct 26); 2014 had two; 2010 had three. All were mid-to-late October.

National pattern: Georgia's Atlanta Press Club governor debate is Oct 12; Florida's 'Before YOU Vote' governor debate is Oct 15 at FAU; Michigan's Benson committed to two October debates; Nevada's Aaron Ford explicitly demanded all debates be held after Labor Day; Maine's earliest is Oct 1.
